prompt:
Use case: historical-scene / stylized-concept.
Asset type: a visual historical female clothing reference atlas for original anime/game character design.
Primary request: EXACTLY 16 complete adult women wearing SIXTEEN clearly distinct historical outfits, IN THE ORDER specified below. Costume structure is the subject. Same mature adult body proportions, calm face, stable natural standing pose and consistent scale throughout; historically appropriate hairstyles and a few helpful clothing accessories. NOT a modern fantasy costume lineup. Use the specified period features rather than mixing all eras together.
Canvas: portrait, 2048x3072 if available. EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 4 equal rows, thin continuous pale-gray grid rules at the exact quarter axes. Top left of each cell: ONLY its exact FH ID in small dark lettering; no other words, no dates, no heading, no text outside the cells. Read left to right then down in the specified order. Generous margins: whole head, hair or hat, BOTH hands, entire garments, hem, both shoes, and any small train remain INSIDE the own cell. Never clip a skirt or hat at a grid boundary. Keep figures similar height even when skirts vary in width; scale widest skirts down as needed.
Style: high-quality original 2D anime historical-fashion illustration, mature adult women aged 25-35, precise clean lines, restrained cel shading, realistic garment layering and textile folds. Warm ivory background, subtle consistent ground contact, gentle studio lighting. Mostly front or three-quarter front view, except where profile makes the garment change more legible. Different muted costume colors aid comparison, not claims of exact archaeological fabric colors.
Coverage: fully opaque outer clothing and appropriate covered underlayers, no transparency, no nudity, no exposed underwear, no sexual poses. Historically lower necklines get a modest plausible opaque inset or fichu without changing the primary skirt/sleeve silhouette. Plain original fabrics, subtle small motifs only; no brands or copied artworks.
Anatomy: exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet for every woman. Natural upright pose, hands separated from torso enough to read seams, no props obscuring the outfit. This is a clothing development comparison: prioritize waist placement, collar, sleeves, skirt support direction and hem length.

Framing is critical: leave at least 15px ivory margins beyond every side of the full garment, sleeves, headdress and hem. Reduce the whole figure scale when a robe is broad or crown is tall. Never cut off a skirt at the grid. No extra limbs or repeated knees. Use a different ORIGINAL adult model when appropriate to the region, with natural varied skin tones, without caricatures.

Track: 中国时段与衣着转折补充. Scope: 战国至1990年代，补充原组未收录的时代、袍裙结构与近现代搭配.
Chinese supplement: make the straight Han hem different from winding quju; distinguish tunic/trousers from skirts; show Tang half-sleeve BANBI over long sleeves; Liao round neck versus Yuan noble robe and tall gugu crown; Ming SLEEVELESS long bijia; Qing changyi OPEN-SIDE outer robe over fully covered inner robe; then jacket/trousers, qipao+jacket, and modern skirt suit. No generic modern hanfu for all16.

Cell 1 ID FH049: 战国楚地绣绵袍示意 / Warring States Chu padded silk robe. Reference period 约前4—前3世纪; region 中国·楚地. Opaque muted red-brown padded silk cross-collar long robe, wearer left front over right, broad dark embroidered borders, softly rounded long sleeves and winding ankle hem, simple tied hair, no modern obi
Cell 2 ID FH050: 汉代直裾长袍示意 / Han straight-hem long robe. Reference period 约前2—前1世纪; region 中国·汉代. Opaque ochre straight-hem cross-collar ankle robe, wearer left front over right, dark edge bands, simple waist sash, flat relatively straight lower hem rather than winding spiral wrap, Han adult hair bun
Cell 3 ID FH051: 北朝裤褶女装示意 / Northern Dynasties jacket and trousers. Reference period 约5—6世纪; region 中国·北朝. Mature woman in muted moss narrow-sleeved belted knee-length cross-collar tunic over loose fully covered trousers and soft boots, compact practical silhouette, no armor or long skirt
Cell 4 ID FH052: 隋代高腰长裙示意 / Sui high-waist long-skirt ensemble. Reference period 约6世纪末—7世纪初; region 中国·隋代. Opaque cream narrow-sleeved short blouse, long muted coral high-waisted pleated skirt and narrow scarf laid over arms, modest neckline, simple tall bun, no modern bridal styling
Cell 5 ID FH053: 唐代半臂衫裙 / Tang banbi short-sleeve over-jacket set. Reference period 约7—8世纪; region 中国·唐代. Muted green SHORT elbow-sleeve open-front banbi vest over opaque cream long-sleeve blouse and ochre full-length skirt, visible contrast between short outer sleeves and long inner sleeves, narrow scarf
Cell 6 ID FH054: 五代襦衫长裙示意 / Five Dynasties blouse and long skirt. Reference period 约10世纪; region 中国·五代. Opaque pale pink long-sleeve blouse, high-waisted muted teal slender full-length skirt, narrow hanging scarf, small high bun, restrained drape and modest neckline, no enormous Tang fantasy sleeves
Cell 7 ID FH055: 辽代圆领女袍示意 / Liao round-neck woman's robe. Reference period 约11世纪; region 中国·辽代北方. Mature woman in muted dark rust ROUND-NECK long narrow-sleeve ankle robe with side fastening and plain waist belt, soft boots, simple covered hair, no giant Qing headpiece or modern qipao fit
Cell 8 ID FH056: 金代北方衫裙示意 / Jin-period northern blouse and skirt. Reference period 约12—13世纪; region 中国·金代北方. Opaque muted cream long-sleeved blouse under dark high-waisted long skirt, simple cloth-wrapped hair bun, narrow pibo-like scarf over arms, northern mural-inspired silhouette, no Mongol gugu crown
Cell 9 ID FH057: 元代蒙古贵族女袍 / Yuan Mongol noblewoman's robe. Reference period 约13—14世纪; region 中国·元代蒙古贵族. Muted deep blue broad straight floor robe with broad long sleeves, narrow waist sash, tall restrained red gugu crown with small feather, Mongol noblewoman, scale crown and full hem to fit cell
Cell 10 ID FH058: 元代南方衫裙示意 / Yuan southern blouse and skirt. Reference period 约13—14世纪; region 中国·元代南方. Opaque pale apricot long-sleeve blouse, muted wine pleated floor skirt at high-natural waist, modest small floral hair ornament, simple sash, no tall gugu crown, no imperial dragon robe
Cell 11 ID FH059: 明代比甲裙装 / Ming bijia vest and skirt. Reference period 约16—17世纪; region 中国·明代. Long muted navy sleeveless open-front bijia vest reaching below knee over opaque pale rose long-sleeve blouse and cream pleated long skirt, simple flat front skirt panel, visible sleeveless armholes, no Qing court collar
Cell 12 ID FH060: 清代氅衣层搭 / Qing changyi outer-robe layering. Reference period 约19世纪; region 中国·清代满族宫廷. Muted plum straight ankle changyi outer robe with long side openings beginning near underarm and ruyi cloud-shaped trim, worn over fully opaque blue-gray long inner robe, narrow cuffs, restrained Manchu hairstyle
Cell 13 ID FH061: 1920年代袄裤便装 / 1920s Chinese jacket and trousers. Reference period 约1920—1930年代; region 中国·城市日常. Mature adult in pale lavender modest standing-collar side-closing hip-length blouse, wide full-length dark trousers and cloth flats, simple bob, no school emblems or military badges
Cell 14 ID FH062: 1940年代旗袍短外套 / 1940s qipao and Western-style jacket. Reference period 约1940—1950年代; region 中国·城市着装. Muted burgundy below-calf qipao with modest collar and low slit, plain cream tailored short jacket with small lapels and buttons, low heels and small handbag, period waved hair, no logos
Cell 15 ID FH063: 1950年代中式上衣长裤 / 1950s Chinese blouse and trousers. Reference period 约1950—1960年代; region 中国·日常着装. Mature woman in muted pale blue modest side-fastened long-sleeve Chinese blouse, dark relaxed straight trousers, simple cloth shoes, plain tied hair, no military insignia or political slogans
Cell 16 ID FH064: 1980年代城市女套装 / 1980s Chinese urban skirt suit. Reference period 约1980—1990年代; region 中国·城市成衣. Mature Chinese woman in muted teal lightly padded-shoulder tailored jacket, ivory modest blouse, navy below-knee straight skirt, low pumps and plain handbag, natural short curled hair, no logos

Track: 日本与朝鲜半岛女装. Scope: 日本与朝鲜半岛两条并行路线；相邻参照仅在各自路线内显示.
Two PARALLEL histories in one sheet: Japanese cells1,2,4,6,7,9,13,15; Korean cells3,5,8,10,11,12,14,16. Keep identities of garments precise: kimono/kosode are straight-cut with left front over right; uchikake is unbelted OUTER robe; obi width differs by era. Korean jeogori+chima are separate jacket and gathered skirt with white collar bands and goreum ties, NOT kimono or qipao. Dangui has longer curved front panels; wonsam has broad sleeves and cuff bands; hwarot is red embroidered formal robe; jeogui is deep blue ceremonial robe. All figures clearly mature adults, no anime schoolgirls.
Ordered cells:
Cell 1 ID FH065: 平安时期重衫礼装 / Heian layered uchiki court attire. Reference period 约12世纪; region 日本·宫廷. Mature Japanese court woman in opaque layered uchiki court robes with cream, moss and muted red nested collar and sleeve edges, red hakama beneath, long straight dark hair, compact short train fully inside cell, no modern wide obi
Cell 2 ID FH066: 室町时期小袖外着 / Muromachi kosode as outerwear. Reference period 约16世纪; region 日本. Muted ochre straight T-shaped kosode with small wrist openings, wearer left front over right, narrow soft tied sash, ankle hem, restrained small motifs and simple tied hair, no modern wide obi or bustle bow
Cell 3 ID FH067: 朝鲜前期长赤古里裙装 / Early Joseon longer jeogori and chima. Reference period 约16世纪; region 朝鲜半岛·朝鲜王朝. Mature Korean woman in opaque pale green hip-to-waist length jeogori with white collar band and modest ties, long muted rust gathered chima whose waistband is covered by jacket, no cropped jacket, simple bun
Cell 4 ID FH068: 桃山时期打挂式外袍 / Momoyama uchikake-style outer robe. Reference period 约16世纪后半; region 日本. Muted cream and rust patterned open uchikake-style long outer robe worn UNBELTED over opaque dark kosode with narrow inner sash, full rounded padded hem inside cell, natural hands, no obi tied over outer coat
Cell 5 ID FH069: 朝鲜中期赤古里裙装 / Mid-Joseon jeogori and chima. Reference period 约17世纪; region 朝鲜半岛·朝鲜王朝. Mature Korean woman in opaque ivory waist-length jeogori with white collar strip, visible muted red ties, long muted indigo gathered chima, jacket longer than late-Joseon cropped form, simple bun and flats
Cell 6 ID FH070: 江户初期窄带小袖 / Early Edo narrow-obi kosode. Reference period 约17世纪; region 日本. Muted russet kosode with restrained large diagonal plant shapes, narrow dark soft obi tied simply at back, wearer left front over right, ankle hem and plain sandals, no modern huge bow or geisha caricature
Cell 7 ID FH071: 江户中期宽带小袖 / Mid-Edo wide-obi kosode. Reference period 约18世纪; region 日本. Muted blue-green opaque kosode with lower-hem small botanical motifs, clearly broad cream obi with restrained back knot visible in three-quarter view, left front over right, full hem and sandals, no huge trailing sash
Cell 8 ID FH072: 朝鲜后期短赤古里裙装 / Late Joseon short jeogori and high chima. Reference period 约19世纪; region 朝鲜半岛·朝鲜王朝. Mature Korean woman in fully opaque very short pale yellow jeogori with white collar and long red goreum ties, high-waisted voluminous muted rose chima covering torso beneath jacket, no visible midriff, neat bun
Cell 9 ID FH073: 江户末期长振袖 / Late Edo furisode silhouette. Reference period 约19世纪; region 日本·礼服. Mature adult woman wearing muted ivory and plum formal furisode with clearly long hanging sleeves, wide gold-beige obi and modest back knot, left front over right, ankle hem and sandals, full sleeves inside cell, no child styling
Cell 10 ID FH074: 朝鲜唐衣礼服 / Joseon dangui court jacket. Reference period 约19世纪; region 朝鲜半岛·礼服. Mature Korean woman in muted dark green dangui with curved long front panels, white collar and purple ties over fully opaque red chima, modest gold roundels and simple formal bun, not a Chinese qipao
Cell 11 ID FH075: 朝鲜圆衫礼服 / Joseon wonsam ceremonial robe. Reference period 约19世纪; region 朝鲜半岛·礼服. Mature Korean adult in muted green ceremonial wonsam with wide sleeves, multicolored horizontal sleeve-end bands and wide red waist belt over opaque long skirt, compact formal headpiece, full sleeves and hem inside cell
Cell 12 ID FH076: 朝鲜阔衣刺绣礼服 / Joseon hwarot embroidered ceremonial robe. Reference period 约19世纪; region 朝鲜半岛·婚礼服. Mature Korean woman in opaque deep red hwarot ceremonial robe with broad sleeves, modest floral embroidery and colored bands near white cuffs, long skirt and simple bridal formal hair ornament, no Chinese imperial crown

Track: 南亚、西亚与其他地域选编. Scope: 主要选取18—20世纪的区域服饰；年代用于定位，区域之间不构成先后替代链.
This is a curated REGIONAL SELECTION, NOT one chronological progression or stereotype of a culture. Read cells in given order; each outfit belongs to its own place and reference date. South Asian peshwaz/ghagra/sari/salwar must be visibly different. Entari reveals opaque blouse+trousers under open robe; bindalli is a closed velvet formal dress. Qajar SHORT skirt is worn OVER fully opaque LONG TROUSERS. Vietnamese ao ngu than and ao dai have long pants under long side panels, not bare-leg qipao. Kebaya front-open blouse has an OPAQUE underlayer, no see-through textile. Kente uses strip-woven cloth and an opaque blouse; no mens royal wrap. Mexican Tehuana square huipil+ruffled skirt differs from Panamanian white embroidered pollera. Adapted full-coverage inner layers are intentional for the reference style. Do not copy a sacred, royal or personal textile pattern; use original restrained motifs.
